extension.description: Copy path with line numbers, change case, align by regex, and a plain text mode for large files.
config.pathStyle: Path format used when copying path with line numbers.
config.pathStyle.relative: Path relative to the workspace folder; falls back to the absolute path when no workspace is open.
config.pathStyle.tilde: Path starting with ~ when the file is under your home directory; otherwise the absolute path.
config.separator: Separator between path and line numbers (any string).
config.multiLineFormat: How to format multiple selected lines.
config.multiLineFormat.range: Merge consecutive lines into ranges, e.g. path:3-4,8.
config.multiLineFormat.list: List every line number, e.g. path:3,4,8.
config.multiLineFormat.perLine: One line per line number, e.g. path:3 / path:4 / path:8.
config.alignTemplates: Named regular expression templates for Align by RegEx, e.g. { "assign": "=|,|:" }.
config.promptSizeMB: Offer plain text mode when an opened file is at least this many MB. Set to 0 to never ask.
config.autoApplyExtensions: File extensions that always open in plain text mode without asking, e.g. [".log", ".csv"].
config.advanced: Incremental overrides for built-in defaults. Only the keys you set are changed; everything else keeps its built-in value. Inside `plainText.editorOverrides`, a value of `null` removes a built-in override instead of replacing it.
advanced.useLineCountSyntax: Write a multi-line fragment as `a+n` (start line plus line count) instead of the closed interval `a-b`. Single lines stay `a` and multiple fragments stay comma separated either way. Built-in default: false.
advanced.includeDotInCurrentWord: When converting the word under the cursor, treat dots as part of the word. Built-in default: false.
advanced.rememberLastInput: Prefill the Align by RegEx input box with the previous expression. Built-in default: true.
advanced.applyEditorSettings: In plain text mode, write [plaintext] language-scoped editor settings that turn off expensive rendering. Built-in default: true.
advanced.disableLineNumbers: Also hide line numbers in plain text mode. Built-in default: false.
advanced.editorOverrides: Incremental changes to the built-in [plaintext] editor overrides. Set a setting id to a value to change it, or to null to drop the built-in override.
